name: After recital R
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text: Ra. whereas the granting of asylum to Iranian nationals in the EU has sharply declined since 2023, despite the ongoing and intensifying violent repression in Iran; whereas both Iranian asylum seekers whose applications have been rejected and Iranian nationals entering the EU on Schengen visas face a risk of deportation, in violation of the principle of non-refoulement;
